result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility and styling issue where promotional banner text has very low contrast against its background.

issues.description: The promotional banner ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white text on a pale mint-green background, resulting in severely insufficient color contrast that makes the text hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or charcoal) or darken the banner's background color to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.
